• Working collaboratively across the three lines of defence, keeping accountability clear between first line ownership, second line oversight and third line assurance

You…
You will come from a risk, compliance, advisory or assurance environment within Australian financial services, and you will understand how good risk management works in practice.

You will ideally bring:
• Experience in risk, compliance, regulatory advisory or assurance within Australian financial services
• A strong understanding of the three lines of defence model and the responsibilities of second line
• Experience interpreting regulatory requirements and turning them into practical frameworks, controls and processes
• Experience developing or enhancing risk frameworks, obligations registers, risk registers, control libraries or assurance programs
• Hands on experience with risk assessments, control assessments and assurance reviews, covering both control design and operating effectiveness
• Knowledge of the Australian financial services regulatory environment, including ASIC requirements and exposure to AFSL obligations
• Strong initiative and a self-starter mindset, with the ability to work independently and prioritise without close direction
• An advisory approach that works constructively with first line stakeholders
• Confidence communicating findings to senior stakeholders and turning complex information into clear, commercially relevant recommendations

How to apply…
If you are a risk professional who enjoys taking a regulatory requirement and building something practical around it, this is a rare chance to help shape a newly created role and a growing enterprise risk function.

The Company...
Our client is a highly regarded Australian business with an established market presence, strong industry reputation, and an expanding technology function. As they continue to invest in digital transformation, they are seeking a Software Developer to join their close knit team and play a key role in delivering critical applications and platform enhancements.
This is an opportunity to work on meaningful projects, influence technical direction, and have genuine ownership of the solutions you build.

The Role...
As a Software Developer, you'll work across a modern technology stack, contributing to both new development and the ongoing evolution of core business systems.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing, building and maintaining full stack applications using React and modern backend technologies
  • Developing and supporting custom APIs, an in house CRM platform, and new Point of Sale (POS) functionality
  • Building serverless, event driven solutions leveraging Azure Functions and cloud native services
  • Contributing to the ongoing development and optimisation of CRM data structures and architecture
  • Taking ownership of projects and technical decisions, with the autonomy to recommend and implement best practice solutions
  • Collaborating closely with a small, highly engaged internal technology team

About You...
To be successful in this role, you will bring:

  • Commercial experience as a Full Stack Developer or Backend Developer
  • Strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills, along with hands on experience building modern React applications (React 18, Vite)
  • The ability to work across the full development lifecycle, from user interface through to backend services and data
  • Strong Python development experience
  • Experience building serverless or event driven applications using Azure Functions or equivalent AWS or GCP services
  • Knowledge of OAuth2 and token based authentication, with MSAL and Microsoft Entra ID experience highly regarded
  • Experience working with Git, pull request workflows, and ideally Azure DevOps
  • A pragmatic, solutions focused approach with strong communication skills and a commitment to writing clean, maintainable code

What's On Offer...

  • Genuine ownership and autonomy in a collaborative environment
  • Exposure to modern cloud and serverless technologies
  • The opportunity to influence architecture and technical direction
  • A stable and growing Australian business investing in technology
  • Long term career growth within a supportive team culture

How to Apply...
This position is based full time onsite at the company's Gold Coast office. Please only apply if you are able to commit to working onsite five days per week.
To apply, click the Apply button or contact Jenny Quigley at SB Recruitment on 02 9002 5005 for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Call Centre Officer | NSW Government
job.description:
The Company
Our client is a well-known NSW Government organisation committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences and making it easier for the community to access government services.

They are seeking enthusiastic and motivated Call Centre Officers to join their high-performing and dynamic team on an exciting contract opportunity until 31 December 2026, based in Dubbo.


The Job
Reporting through to a Team Leader, you will be responsible for the following duties:

  • Respond to phone and live-chat enquiries and communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to deliver high-quality customer service.
  • Accurately process applications and data within required timeframes using relevant systems.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer communications and feedback.
  • Provide effective administrative support, including data entry, word processing and spreadsheet use.
  • Perform general administrative tasks to support team operations.


You
To qualify for this opportunity, you must have experience in the following areas and possess the personal qualities below:

  • Minimum 12 months’ experience in an admin or call-centre environments.
  • Strong data entry and transaction-processing skills.
  • Proficiency with administrative systems, ticketing platforms and Microsoft Office.
  • Experience working in the government sector is desirable.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated customer service skills with strong attention to detail.


How to apply
Our client is seeking candidates who can join their team immediately. To apply, please submit your application via the relevant job boards.

Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

job.title: Mortgage Collections Officer | hybrid
job.description:
The Company…..
Our client is a highly regarded specialist lender with an established presence across Australia and New Zealand. Known for flexible home loan solutions and a customer first philosophy, they support customers whose financial circumstances sit outside traditional lending models.
The culture is collaborative and supportive, built on integrity, teamwork and service excellence. Leaders are approachable and experienced, and committed to positive outcomes for both customers and employees.

The Job…..
A permanent opportunity is available in the Sydney CBD office, with an immediate start or four weeks’ notice both welcome.
Reporting to the Collections Manager, you will manage a portfolio of consumer mortgage accounts 30 to 90 days in arrears. The role calls for a balanced approach: achieving strong recovery outcomes while treating every customer with empathy and respect.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Contacting customers about overdue accounts and recovering arrears in a professional, respectful manner
  • Negotiating and implementing realistic repayment arrangements tailored to each customer’s circumstances
  • Monitoring repayment plans and following up on commitments
  • Working with Customer Service, Credit and Legal teams to resolve matters efficiently
  • Maintaining accurate records and complying with internal processes and regulatory requirements
  • Meeting individual KPIs while contributing to a collaborative, high performing team

You…..
To be successful, you will bring:

  • A minimum of 18 months’ collections experience in financial services, mortgage collections experience is preferred, however for the right candidate training can be provided
  • Confidence when handling sensitive conversations about overdue accounts
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and organisation
  • A proactive mindset and the ability to integrate quickly into an established team

How to apply….
If you bring genuine empathy and are seeking a long term permanent role with a well regarded financial services organisation, we would love to hear from you. Email your CV to jquigley@sbrecruitment.com or call Jenny on 02 9002 5005 for a confidential conversation.
